articles.summary: Many law firms run a familiar calculation each year. HR and talent leaders look at the cost of their current performance review platform: the per-attorney annual fee, the implementation amortization, the support contract, and conclude the number is reasonable enough to keep running. The reviews get done.
articles.title: Identifying Hidden Costs of Your Performance Review Platform
